title: DynamicFields reference vocabulary
description: Asserting keywords: what a value refers to (a file, a keyword, a term, a lookup item), the files an asset value takes, and the limits of a whole content tree. The owner module checks that a reference exists; the tree keywords sit on a root (post) field's schema.

refKind.description: What the value refers to; its owner module checks that it exists.

accept.description: The files an asset value takes: content types (image/png), families (image/*) or extensions (.pdf).

lookup.description: The lookup a lookup value picks from (GET /api/lookups lists them).

uniqueNodeIds.description: Every node id in the tree is used once.

maxDepth.description: How many levels the tree nests at most.

maxNodes.description: How many nodes the tree holds at most.
